next_step_summary: Local provider experiment v6 completed on the ten-case synthetic/sanitized security corpus: 705.02 seconds total, 8/10 cases completed, 14 provider attempts, gemini-3.6-flash succeeded on 8 cases, and gemini-3.5-flash succeeded on 0 of 4 fallback attempts; two 3.6 responses were invalid JSON and four 3.5 attempts returned provider_overloaded. PR #270 adds a bounded local model-selection launcher with gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.7-flash, and gemini-3.5-flash as primary choices while keeping at most one fallback, gemini-3.5-flash, and excluding 3.8. After PR #270 validation/merge, run the same ten-case synthetic/sanitized experiment with 3.7 as primary and compare latency, completion rate, provider failures, and semantic score against the v6 3.6 baseline. Real contracts/raw OCR/recoverable PII remain prohibited from this diagnostic harness.
